plan.notes: Source: the official Reed College Computer Science department 'Scheduling' page (https://www.reed.edu/computer-science/scheduling.html), 'Sample schedule' table - the department's published term-by-term sample sequence for a 'typical' Reed computer science major, read 2026-09-30. CREDENTIAL HONESTY: Reed awards the Bachelor of Arts; there is no BS in Computer Science - degree recorded as BA, no substitution. Transcription method: direct term-by-term transcription of the official sample-schedule table as rendered; course codes, titles, unit values, and prerequisites taken from official Reed catalog course descriptions (catalog archives at reed.edu, catalogs 2018-19 through 2022-23, plus the 2025-26 catalog course listing). Major requirements cross-checked and identical across all of those catalogs: Mathematics 111 (or equivalent), 112, 113, 201; Computer Science 121 and 221; Computer Science 382, 387, 389; four additional CS units numbered higher than 300 (excluding 470); Computer Science 470 (thesis). CATALOG YEAR: the current published catalog is 2025-26; the sample schedule is the department's current live page and matches the current catalog's requirements exactly. CREDIT CONVERSION: Reed uses a unit system; per the official Reed transcript key (reed.edu/registrar), ONE REED UNIT = 4 SEMESTER HOURS. Every full course = 1 unit = 4 credits. Two exceptions, both per the official 2025-26 catalog: (1) HUM 110 'Introduction to the Humanities' is a three-unit yearlong course, 1.5 units per semester = 6 credits per semester; (2) CSCI 470 'Thesis (Computer Science)' is a two-unit yearlong course, one unit per semester = 4 credits per semester. Repeated courses across semesters use distinct codes (HUM 110-2, CSCI 470-2) per pipeline rules. TOTAL CREDITS: the sequence sums to 31 units = 124 semester hours; the BA degree minimum is 30 units (120 semester hours, per the Faculty Code). Per the Clarkson/UVM/GCSU precedent, total_credits=124 is the sequence's OWN published total; the discrepancy is documented here, not padded: the sample's first-year semesters each carry 3.5 units because HUM 110 weighs 1.5 units per semester. PREREQS (official catalog only, never invented): CSCI 221 requires CSCI 121; CSCI 382 and CSCI 387 require CSCI 121 (or equivalent) plus MATH 112 and 113; CSCI 389 requires CSCI 221; MATH 112 requires MATH 111 (or equivalent); MATH 201 requires MATH 112. MATH 113 has no college prerequisites (official Reed math advising guide). 'Or equivalent'/placement alternatives are assessment details, kept in notes per validator rules. Junior qualifying exam (covers CSCI 121, CSCI 221, MATH 113; take before end of sophomore year) is modeled as a 0-credit required milestone (required_zero: true) in Spring Year 2. Choice slots: four 'Csci elective' slots = any CS course numbered 300+ except 382/387/389 (department's own definition; the major's 'four additional units' rule also excludes 470); Group I/II/III slots = Reed distribution requirements, freely movable per the department; remaining 'Elective' slots = free electives. CAVEAT: the department notes 'almost no one is completely typical' - this is a starting-point sample, transcribed verbatim, not an individually advised plan.
